column1: # The owner acceptance register — one row per case the OWNER stated, and the
# test that proves it. Read by csi-spl-iac/src/bash/tests/owner-acceptance-register.tst.sh,
# which fails when a row names a test that is not in the tree, so this file
# cannot rot into a list of promises. Tab separated; `#` starts a comment.
# runner   how the case is exercised, and therefore where it runs:
#          node-e2e   a puppeteer-core proof against a DEPLOYED host (not in CI: needs a browser + a signed-in member)
#          orc-e2e    a ./run action against a live env             (not in CI: needs GCP + a tenant root key)
#          spawn-tst  csi-spl-orc/src/bash/features/spawn-agents/tests/ (never in CI by 016 FR-011: needs a tmux server)
#          manual     a human has to do it; the procedure is in spec.md §5
# status   PASS / FAIL / UNVERIFIED (the test is in the tree, not yet run
#          against the live env) / PENDING (no test yet) / MANUAL
